title: He Failed 5,126 Times. Then Built a Billion Dollar Company.
description:
James Dyson spent about five years building 5,127 prototypes of a bagless vacuum cleaner. Big manufacturers turned the idea down. He started his own company instead.

The story of the prototype count that became famous, and what it actually took.

#motivation #success #inventors

scenes.narration: This man built five thousand one hundred twenty seven versions of the same machine.
In the late nineteen seventies, James Dyson was annoyed that his vacuum cleaner kept losing suction as the bag clogged.
He saw a sawmill use a cyclone to pull dust out of the air, and wondered if that could work in a vacuum.
For about five years he built prototype after prototype, while his wife's teaching job helped keep the family afloat.
Big companies turned his design down. So he started his own company and launched the Dyson in nineteen ninety three.
Within a few years it was the best selling vacuum in Britain. Every failed prototype taught him something the next one needed.
